title: Kourtney Kardashian: The Evolution of a Reality Star
description: Explore the life, career, and business ventures of Kourtney Kardashian, from her early reality TV days to modern lifestyle branding.

sections.heading: Who is Kourtney Kardashian?
paragraphs: Kourtney Kardashian is an American media personality, socialite, and businesswoman. She first gained widespread public attention as a primary cast member of the long-running reality television series 'Keeping Up with the Kardashians', which documented the personal and professional lives of the Kardashian-Jenner family for two decades.

As the eldest of the Kardashian siblings, Kourtney often played the role of the grounded, sometimes skeptical voice of reason on the show. Over the years, her role expanded from reality television star to digital entrepreneur, influencing fashion and lifestyle trends across the globe.

sections.heading: Early Life and Family Background
paragraphs: Born on April 18, 1979, in Los Angeles, California, Kourtney is the daughter of the late high-profile attorney Robert Kardashian and television personality Kris Jenner. She grew up in Los Angeles alongside her younger siblings Kim, Khloé, and Rob.

Following her parents' divorce, her mother married Olympic decathlon champion Caitlyn Jenner (then Bruce Jenner), expanding the family to include half-sisters Kendall and Kylie Jenner, as well as several step-siblings. Kourtney attended Southern Methodist University before transferring to the University of Arizona, where she graduated with a Bachelor of Arts degree in Theatre Arts and a minor in Spanish.

sections.heading: Rise to Fame and Reality Television
paragraphs: The Kardashian family's ascent to global fame began in late 2007 with the premiere of 'Keeping Up with the Kardashians' on the E! network. The show became a cultural phenomenon and spawned numerous spin-offs, several of which Kourtney starred in or executive produced, including 'Kourtney and Khloé Take Miami' and 'Kourtney and Kim Take New York'.

Her relationship dynamics, parenting journey, and personal growth were heavily featured throughout the franchise. In 2021, the family transitioned from cable television to a new streaming series titled simply 'The Kardashians', continuing to document their lives for a dedicated international audience.

sections.heading: Business Ventures and Lifestyle Brands
paragraphs: Beyond television, Kourtney has established herself as an entrepreneur. In 2019, she launched Poosh, a lifestyle website and e-commerce platform focused on wellness, home decor, beauty, and sustainable living.

Her business interests also extend into fashion collaborations and various beauty partnerships. By leveraging her massive social media following, she has successfully curated digital storefronts and promoted products centered around health, fitness, and mindful living.
